about: The AP Calculus AB app pages. scripts/build-apcalc.mjs writes each page's shell (head, header, footer, a <div id="app"> mount) from this file; the page's behavior is its script in calculus/assets/<script>, which mounts into #app. "static": true marks a generated page that is not an app (teachers.html). premium names the Premium feature (ApCalcCore gates it); card is the line on the course home. No path may contain the token "ap" (docs/apcalc-spec.md decision 2). tools[] are the eleven trainers of docs/apcalc-spec.md section 6, pre-registered in Phase 0: page calculus/tools/<slug>.html, script calculus/assets/tools/<slug>.js, model calculus/assets/tools/math/<slug>.js (ApCalcMath.<camelSlug>), content calculus/data/tools/<slug>.json, validator scripts/lib/apcalc-tool-checks/<slug>.mjs, test scripts/test/apcalc-tool-<slug>.test.mjs (docs/apcalc-architecture.md, "Tools"). topic is the tool's context topic: the tool is built only when its data file exists and that topic is published. Free or Premium: motion-graphs, free-body-diagrams and scaling-drills are free; the rest carry "premium": "tools" (docs/apcalc-spec.md decision on free trainers; owner to confirm).

apps.title: Practice questions
apps.desc: Calculus practice by unit, topic or skill: graphs and tables in stimulus sets, typed expressions graded by value, calculator and no-calculator questions.
apps.card: Drill a unit, a topic or a mathematical practice, with graph and table sets.

apps.title: Spaced review
apps.desc: Your calculus spaced review queue: every question you missed comes back just before you would forget it.
apps.card: Missed questions come back when you are about to forget them.

apps.title: Unit tests and practice exams
apps.desc: Timed calculus unit tests and full practice exams in the real format: 29 + 13 multiple-choice questions without and with a calculator, then 2 + 4 free-response questions.
apps.card: Unit tests and full timed practice exams in the real four-part format.

apps.title: Free-response practice
apps.desc: Calculus free-response practice in the recurring exam types, each worth 9 points, with a point-by-point rubric, a full-credit sample answer and a printable answer sheet.
apps.card: Every recurring free-response type, with 9-point rubrics and sample answers.

apps.title: Justification trainer
apps.desc: Calculus justification practice: name the theorem, check its hypotheses, state the conclusion, then compare an answer that earns the point with one that does not.
apps.lede: Write a justification, then check it against the rubric and two model answers: one that earns the point and one that loses it.
apps.card: Justify with the right theorem and its hypotheses, checked against a rubric.

apps.title: Cram kit
apps.desc: Calculus cram plans counted back from your exam date: three or two weeks, day by day, weighted by unit, with unit sheets, timed mixed sets and practice exams.
apps.lede: A 3-week or 2-week plan counted back from your exam date, day by day: unit sheets and notes, a timed mixed set and one free-response question each study day, two full practice exams and rest days. Print it and tick the days off.
apps.card: 3-week and 2-week plans to exam day, and timed mixed sets.

apps.title: Flashcards
apps.desc: Spaced-repetition calculus flashcards built from the glossary, by unit and topic.

apps.title: Trainers
apps.desc: Calculus trainers: a tangent tracer, a limit explorer, derivative rule drills, related rates, motion, curve analysis, Riemann sums, accumulation, slope fields, area and volume.
apps.card: Trainers and drills, then the questions about what you did.

apps.title: Your dashboard
apps.desc: Your calculus mastery by unit, topic and mathematical practice, with every miss linked to the lesson that teaches it.
apps.card: Mastery by unit, topic and mathematical practice.

apps.title: Search the course
apps.desc: Search every calculus lesson, notes page, glossary term and tool in the course.

apps.title: For teachers
apps.desc: For calculus teachers: stable share links, printable notes and unit sheets, and sharing pages to Google Classroom, with no new student data collected.
apps.lede: Share any notes page, lesson or unit sheet with a stable link. Students need no account, and nothing they do leaves their device unless they choose to sign in.

tools.name: Limit explorer
tools.title: Limit Explorer
tools.desc: Zoom in on a graph near a point: one-sided limits, holes, jumps, asymptotes and the squeeze theorem, with a table of values closing in.
tools.blurb: Zoom in on a point and watch the limit from each side.
tools.lede: Zoom in on a graph and a table until the limit is clear.

tools.name: Tangent tracer
tools.title: Tangent Tracer
tools.desc: Drag a point along a curve: the secant line becomes the tangent as h shrinks, the derivative graph draws itself, and you sketch f′ from f.
tools.blurb: The secant becomes the tangent; the derivative draws itself.
tools.lede: Drag a point and watch the secant line turn into the tangent.

tools.name: Rule drills
tools.title: Derivative Rule Drills
tools.desc: Unlimited derivative drills, step by step: power, product, quotient, chain, implicit and inverse rules, every step typed and graded by value.
tools.blurb: Build a derivative one rule at a time, every step checked.
tools.lede: Build derivatives one rule at a time.

tools.name: Related rates
tools.title: Related Rates Trainer
tools.desc: Animated related rates scenes (a sliding ladder, a filling cone, a shadow, a growing circle) with live rates and the chain of equations.
tools.blurb: Watch rates change together, then write the equation that links them.
tools.lede: See every rate change together as the scene moves.

tools.name: Motion lab
tools.title: Particle Motion Lab
tools.desc: A particle on a line with its position, velocity and acceleration graphs: direction, speeding up and slowing down, displacement and total distance.
tools.blurb: A particle on a line, with its three graphs linked.
tools.lede: Move a particle and watch x, v and a draw themselves.

tools.name: Curve analyzer
tools.title: Curve Analyzer
tools.desc: f, f′ and f″ linked: sign charts, extrema and points of inflection with justifications, the candidates test and optimization scenes.
tools.blurb: Read a function from its derivatives, and justify what you see.
tools.lede: Link f, f′ and f″ and justify each feature.

tools.name: Riemann sums
tools.title: Riemann Sums Trainer
tools.desc: Left, right, midpoint and trapezoidal sums on functions and on tables with unequal widths, with over- and underestimates explained.
tools.blurb: Build left, right, midpoint and trapezoid sums, from graphs and tables.
tools.lede: Fill the area with rectangles and trapezoids.

tools.name: Accumulation
tools.title: Accumulation Function Trainer
tools.desc: g(x) as the integral of a graphed f: watch the area accumulate, read where g increases and bends, and use both parts of the Fundamental Theorem.
tools.blurb: Watch g(x) accumulate the area under f.
tools.lede: See an accumulation function build up from the graph of f.

tools.name: Slope fields
tools.title: Slope Field Trainer
tools.desc: Draw slope fields, trace a solution curve through a point, separate the variables and fit exponential models.
tools.blurb: Draw the field, trace a solution, then solve it exactly.
tools.lede: Trace a solution curve through a slope field.

tools.name: Area and volume
tools.title: Area and Volume Trainer
tools.desc: Area between curves, volumes by discs and washers about any line, and volumes with known cross sections, shown in 3D.
tools.blurb: Regions, discs, washers and cross sections, in 3D.
tools.lede: Turn a region into a solid and build its integral.
